about: X rejects the post as duplicate content with a 403 problem+json body

body.detail: You are not allowed to create a Tweet with duplicate content.
body.title: Forbidden

writeReplies.note: Twitter v2 node create tweet: POST https://api.x.com/2/tweets {text}; the reply is not read downstream.

branches: Verify tweet constraints (model-driven): true when the tweet is over 280 characters → back to Configure your influencer profile and a new generation; false → Post tweet
Post tweet is expected to fail on the 403 in n8n (no error output)
expect.offline: No external read: the profile is static and the tweet is model-written, so the variants differ only in X's reply to the post. The schedule's triggerAtMinute is random (Math.random); the trigger item fixes 4:37. The prompt carries DateTime.now() (run-time masked). twitterOAuth2Api gets a bench OAuth2 dummy
